ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Firework Stand, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
Written, never run. Every step is Pickle's own generic vocabulary, so there is no companion assembly. See TESTING.md in the repository root for the scenarios and Tests/Pickle/README.md for exactly what is and is not covered.
